title: Model Card for OpenAI Privacy Filter
abstract: arXiv:2608.18274v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: OpenAI Privacy Filter is a compact, bidirectional token-classification model for detecting and redacting personally identifiable information (PII) and secrets in unstructured text. The model is derived from an autoregressively pretrained checkpoint and converted into a bidirectional, banded-attention classifier that labels an input sequence in a single forward pass. A constrained Viterbi decoder produces coherent spans across eight privacy categories and exposes configurable operating points for precision-recall tradeoffs. Privacy Filter has 1.5 billion total parameters, 50 million active parameters per token, and a 128,000-token context window. It is designed for efficient local deployment and domain-specific fine-tuning. Privacy Filter is intended as a configurable data-minimization component within layered privacy workflows, not as an anonymization or compliance guarantee.

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18274v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：OpenAI隐私过滤器是一个紧凑的双向令牌分类模型，用于检测和编辑非结构化文本中的个人身份信息（PII）和秘密。该模型源自自回归预训练检查点，并转换为双向带状注意力分类器，在单次前向传递中标记输入序列。受约束的维特比解码器在八个隐私类别中生成连贯的跨度，并提供可配置的精确率-召回率权衡操作点。隐私过滤器共有15亿总参数，每个令牌5000万活跃参数，以及128,000令牌的上下文窗口。它专为高效本地部署和领域特定微调而设计。隐私过滤器旨在作为分层隐私工作流中的可配置数据最小化组件，而非匿名化或合规性保证。
tldr: 本文介绍了一个紧凑的双向令牌分类模型，用于高效检测和编辑PII及秘密，支持可配置精度权衡和本地部署。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a compact bidirectional token-classification model for efficient detection and redaction of PII and secrets, with configurable precision-recall tradeoffs and local deployment.
